title: PageSpec
description: Machine contract for one generated page. Closed template, route, node type and assetRole enums; additionalProperties false everywhere; motion is a closed object whose values are locked per section type to the evidence in sections/*.json. There is deliberately NO per-instance style or token-override field. x-maxWords / x-cloneChars / x-originalChars are documentation-and-validator keywords (JSON Schema ignores them); semantic_validate.py enforces x-maxWords/maxWords from sections/*.json.

prompts.description: Exactly five typed prompts in order: churn, dashboard, spreadsheet, email, schedule (spec lengths c39, c64, c37, c39, c48).
